rationale: The assistant correctly identified the detached impeller and snapped fin as pointing to a failed drain pump, and it avoided overclaiming part compatibility by asking for the rating plate details. It gave sensible first checks in turn one and kept the machine unplugged. It missed the 10-year parts warranty and did not say to drain water before pump removal. It also never directly used the 170 ohm coil reading, which the customer had not mentioned in the conversation anyway.
